messages.text: Conversation started. Priya Shah owns the café next door to Ellery & Finch Books.
Detective, hi! I figured someone would reach out. I was closing up my place around the same time that night.

Their lights went off right around closing time, like normal. But I noticed someone was still moving around inside a while after that — alone, with the front lights off. Struck me as odd enough that I remembered it.

messages.prompt: How do you want to respond?

choices.text: Could you tell about how long after closing that was?
Did you recognize who it was?

msg-00-5a.text: Maybe an hour, hour and a half after? I wasn't watching the clock, but it was well past when they'd normally have locked up and left.

msg-00-5b.text: I couldn't see well enough to be sure, honestly. Just one person, moving around near the counter, lights off. You'd probably want to check whatever camera they've got.

msg-00-6.text: Let me know if you need anything else — Nora's been a good neighbor, I hope this gets sorted out.
